welcome.title: Appointment scheduling for small teams
welcome.headline: Bookings that respect the working day.
welcome.lede: {{name}} holds your opening hours, your staff, your services and your time off in one place, so every slot you offer is one you can actually keep.

slot.definition: A start time we have already checked against opening hours, time off and everything booked.

block.definition: What a booking really consumes: the buffer before, the service itself, the buffer after.

horizon.definition: How far ahead your customers may book. You set it, and the lead time, per business.

agendaPreview.footnote: What is bookable is what is left: business hours, narrowed to the staff member's hours, minus time off, minus everything already booked.
